verdict.rationale: Notion documents an official Notion MCP server that MCP clients such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can connect to. The docs cover OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, tools to search, read, create and update content, confirmation-before-write security guidance, and workspace-owner access controls; an open-source notion-mcp-server package is also offered for self-hosting, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
